# Qefro

> Qefro is an AI Business Application Platform. Connect your existing business software to AI conversations on WhatsApp, Instagram, web chat, and voice to perform real business actions.

Qefro connects AI with your business software (ERP, POS, CRM, billing, and spreadsheets) to execute verified actions — creating invoices, scheduling appointments, taking table reservations, sending UPI payment links, and updating records.

Not a basic chatbot, support bot, generic CRM, LLM wrapper, or isolated automation tool. Two-way sync, schema-constrained actions, and human approval gates keep operations safe.

## Outcome

Conversation → Data → Action → Outcome

AI can answer from indexed knowledge, query records, schedule events, trigger payment links, and complete work. People stay in the loop for permissions, workflows, and sensitive approvals.

## How it starts

1. Connect your tools: Sync Tally, Zoho, Google Sheets, custom APIs, or CSVs.
2. Set your rules: Define allowed actions, role-based access, and approval thresholds.
3. Qefro executes: AI handles inquiries and runs workflows across WhatsApp, web chat, and voice.
4. Human in the loop: Flagged or sensitive actions pause for staff approval before mutation.

## Pricing & Trial

Every plan includes a 14-day free trial with full platform access. No credit card required to start.

- Starter: ₹699/month (₹582/mo billed yearly) — 1 user, 500 CRM contacts, 50 documents, 5 integrations, website chat and WhatsApp.
- Pro: ₹1,499/month (₹1,249/mo billed yearly) — 5 users, 2,500 CRM contacts, 200 documents, 25 integrations, Voice AI, API & webhooks, team role permissions.
- Growth: ₹2,999/month (₹2,499/mo billed yearly) — 15 users, 10,000 CRM contacts, 500 documents, unlimited integrations, Customer 360, advanced reporting.
- Marketplace apps billed separately. Enterprise custom private deployments and SLA.
